title: review output
description: Printed with --json on exit 0, including a --dry-run. A refusal, a dry run included, prints the error envelope.

event.description: The draft's event, or approve with --approve.

head_sha.description: The pinned head; for comment and reply, --expected-head or show's head.

base_ref.description: Untrusted: the pinned base; for comment and reply, show's base ref.

mentions_neutralized.description: Untrusted: names after a replaced @, without it; in order of first appearance, deduplicated in ASCII lowercase.

plan_sha256.description: The final plan's plan_sha256, on every run.

ids.description: forgectl's ids, unordered; empty on a --dry-run.

review_id.description: forgectl's; null on GitLab, for other actions and on a --dry-run.

already_posted.description: Real run: forgectl's answer from the real call (boolean). --dry-run: a hint, true when forgectl's dry run reported it, else null.

follow_up_done.description: forgectl's (it performed a state step on a dedupe hit); null on a --dry-run.

neutralized_lines.description: pr-comment's count from Text pipeline step 6.

markers_removed.description: pr-comment's count from Text pipeline step 6.

warnings.description: forgectl's, plus pr-comment's own (body_thread_unresolved, neutralizing_mismatch); on a --dry-run, pr-comment's.

posted_inline.description: Finding ids posted (or, on a --dry-run, planned) as inline comments.

moved.description: Findings moved to the review body in this run, with reasons.

suggestions_degraded.description: Applicable suggestions rendered as plain code, with reasons; moved findings are excluded (they are in moved).

head_verified.description: forgectl's: false when an earlier approval exists that forgectl cannot confirm counts for this head and base; null otherwise and on a --dry-run.

body_thread_resolved.description: GitLab body-thread resolve: true, false (failed; see warnings), null on GitHub, when the setting does not apply and on a --dry-run.

body_thread_id.description: The GitLab body thread (gl:d:), or null on GitHub, when none was found and on a --dry-run.

reanchored_draft.description: The re-anchored draft (findings that did not map are in its unanchored list), or null without --reanchor-to. pr-comment writes no file.
